title: On a phone or landscape phone every playback frame is a full render
what: #canFast returns null for phone/landscape, so every playhead frame runs the whole render (header, rail, all card signatures, shelf, rows, inspector, lane, transport/playbar/status via innerHTML setHtml, toasts with getBoundingClientRect after writes).
cost: 60 frames/s for all phone playback; the code's own measurement of a full render is 6-30 ms a frame on a desk at 1,000 cuts, estimated 20-100 ms on a phone.
evidence: app.ts:467; #renderEditor uses setHtml for transport/playbar/status; play bar label carries mm:ss.
fix: Let phones take the fast/cut tiers (add the phone's head-driven regions to #renderFast) and use patchHtml in the full render too.

title: Kept-clip audio windows resampled on the main thread, 25 ms per 5 s window
what: A kept clip's window is resampled 48 kHz to the context rate with a ~50-tap sinc in JS on the page thread; at a 44.1 kHz context (and unaligned 48 kHz WAV) every window takes the slow path.
cost: One long task per 5 s of kept playback plus prefetch and 3-4 per seek: measured 24.8 ms per window (V8, desk), estimated 75-125 ms on a phone; breaks PERF.md rule 12 and the 10 ms frame goal.
evidence: Verbatim copy timed in scratch: 44.1k 24.8 ms, 48k unaligned 24.9 ms, 48k aligned 3.1 ms; CHUNK_S = 5.
fix: Resample in a Worker, or keep kept windows at 48 kHz in a 48 kHz AudioBuffer and let Web Audio resample; keep the exact window length.

title: Peaks fetched twice per clip; lane level target drifts from the engine's (q1-k5 shape)
what: Engine and PeaksCache each fetch and parse every .peaks (no memo in the source). PeaksCache's auto-level target is the median of every clip ever loaded, recomputed only when a clip arrives; the engine's is the median of clips in the cut now.
cost: ~36 MB fetched twice (estimated, 50 one-hour clips at 200 B/s) and held twice; after a clip's last cut is removed the lane draws every waveform at a different gain than the engine plays and the export bakes.
evidence: peaks.ts:74-78 vs engine.ts:273-276; keptAudioSource/httpAudioSource peaks keep nothing.
fix: One peaks memo in the source shared by both; derive PeaksCache's target from the current project's clips (or from the engine).

title: Video tab frame loop runs while shown even when paused; rewrites DOM every frame in a gap
what: #tick reschedules every frame while visible regardless of playback; #show writes msg.textContent unconditionally, replacing the text node every frame when a message is showing.
cost: 60-144 wakeups/s for as long as the tab is left open; in a gap or no-preview state also 60-144 DOM mutations, layouts and MutationObserver callbacks a second.
fix: Loop only while playing or settling; redraw on store change otherwise; setText instead of a bare textContent write.

title: Two MutationObservers watch the whole editor or body for one header and one panel
what: tipHeader observes childList over all of #app to patch header buttons; workspace #findObs observes all of body until the transcript panel appears and never disconnects if that feature is off or fails.
cost: A callback per mutation batch: several a second during playback, every frame on a phone; records allocated for every card reconcile. Estimated tens to hundreds of microseconds a frame.
fix: Observe the header element only; have the transcripts feature announce its panel with an event.

title: Card drag does an O(n) layout walk per pointermove with scroll writes before reads
what: Each move queries all cards, reads rects until the landing (all of them for the marquee), rebuilds ctx() and three O(n) order arrays, and writes scrollTop before reading rects (forced layout). Edge auto-scroll only happens on a move.
cost: Once per frame of a drag at 316-1,000 cards; estimated 1-5 ms per move near the edges.
fix: Snapshot rects at drag start and on scroll, binary-search per move, rAF-driven edge scroll.

title: One 1.29 MB eager bundle; 11.6 MB of dead bytes in dist; font warm-up loads unused scripts
what: All 17 feature clients statically imported into main.js; dist ships 216 .woff duplicates (5.9 MB) and 5.7 MB of source maps; warmFonts loads every unloaded face including Cyrillic/Vietnamese/italic.
cost: Parse/compile of 1.29 MB on every open (estimated 50-100 ms desk, 200-400 ms phone); 61% of the 19 MB dist never downloaded by a browser.
fix: Code-split features behind the server's feature list (and add the chunks to the SW precache); drop .woff and maps from the deploy; filter warmFonts to Noto TC + Latin.

title: Whole undo history structured-cloned to IndexedDB after every edit
what: 250 ms after any edit the full undo+redo stacks (up to 200 steps, layout steps carrying every row id) are written as one record.
cost: Per edit; estimated 1-2 MB cloned on the main thread per write at 200 steps on a 500-row list.
fix: Per-step keys or tail-only writes; keep the 200 cap.

title: Store listener runs root.querySelector('.lane') on every store change
what: bindLane is subscribed to the store and walks the DOM (past the whole cards list) on every set, though the lane element is created once.
cost: 60-144 calls/s while playing over 6,000-20,000 nodes; estimated 50-200 us each.
evidence: Code read; Lane built once in App constructor (app.ts:174-175).
fix: Have the views signal a lane element change, or only look when view.mode changes.

title: viewModel builds its own timeline instead of the store's cached one
what: viewModel calls timeline(project) directly, so each new Project's timeline is computed twice (once by timelineOf) and held twice.
cost: One extra O(rows) pass per edit and a duplicate timeline in memory; well under 1 ms.
